models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
models.license: Verify weight licence for commercial use
models.notes: Weights 284B total / 13B active per OpenRouter. KV/token calibrated against the 2x DGX Spark recipe (1,548,597 token pool at util 0.78). A community run on 2x RTX PRO 6000 implies ~10.6 KB/token with FP8 KV - the two are not reconciled. See Benchmarks.
